baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated focus sequence at words 2, 3, 5, 7, and 8 links concealment, obstruction, a way, causative loss, and possessed works.
baseline_models.mechanism: Concealing orientation and diverting others from a traversable means rebounds on the agents' own purposive activity: their undertakings inherit the obstructed geometry and are made unable to arrive at their intended end.

activation_trace.role: Concealment of what should orient a person supplies the initiating loss of visibility in the route mechanism.
Turning oneself or another aside supplies both the outward obstruction and its reversible direction.
A traversable extended route gives the obstruction a concrete course and possible destination.
Deviation from a destination turns the causative verb into failed arrival rather than bare deletion.
Intentionally directed action is the moving item whose purpose can fail to reach completion.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely announces a detached penalty in which bad deeds are cancelled.
changed_reading.after: The penalty mirrors the conduct: those who obstruct access have their own intended undertakings made directionless and unable to arrive.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The covering and barrier branches at words 2 and 3 converge with disappearance at word 7 upon the possessed work at word 8.
baseline_models.mechanism: The agents place covering and a material obstruction over the way; the causative predicate applies an analogous occlusion to the products of their own work, which become buried, absent from view, or unrecoverable rather than simply judged false.

activation_trace.role: A physical act of covering supplies the first layer of occlusion.
A massive intervening barrier converts social prevention into a material blockage.
The route supplies the surface across which covering and blockage operate.
Disappearance into concealment supplies the resulting state of the work product.
Purposive production provides the object whose trace or result can be occluded.

changed_reading.before: Their works remain visible but receive a negative verdict.
changed_reading.after: Their works undergo the same occlusion they impose on the way and cease to be recoverable as successful products.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The disavowal branch at word 2, the possessed plural of work at word 8, and the loss predicate at word 7 permit a labor-and-return relation.
baseline_models.mechanism: Disavowal and diversion sever labor from the route by which its claim or return would come back to its owner. The effort may occur, yet its compensable yield is made into something the worker cannot find or possess.

activation_trace.role: Disavowal supplies the relational severance between an agent and what might answer for the agent.
Diversion interrupts the return path between labor and its owner.
The route acts as the channel through which a result or claim would normally arrive.
Loss of a possessed item gives the work's return the status of an unfindable claim.
The compensation attached to labor supplies the return that can be disconnected from effort.

changed_reading.before: All performed acts are simply erased.
changed_reading.after: A live alternative is that effort remains as exertion while its claim, yield, or compensable return becomes lost to its owner.

context_deltas.mechanism: The matched groups in 47:2-3 are differentiated by what they follow. Work becomes fit and its harmful residue is covered when it follows what is stable; work loses stable realization when it trails what has no durable footing. The focus loss is therefore directional and formative, not an unexplained deletion after the fact.

activation_trace.role: Route deviation remains the focus result now given a directional cause.
Intended acts remain the focus object whose formation depends on orientation.
A covering that removes a harmful trace proves that covering can repair rather than merely hide.
Fitness for a thing supplies the positive condition in which activity coheres with its end.
Trailing behind an object supplies the directional link from orientation to outcome.
Loss of truth and stability supplies the unstable track followed by the first group.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the alternative track on which work can hold.

structural_cues: 47:2-3 place two syntactically matched populations in contrast and repeat work, covering, following, and opposed objects.
The positive side receives both removal of a harmful residue and repair of condition, making the contrast processual rather than merely classificatory.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed objects of following, repair, and two different uses of covering; I infer that followed orientation forms the trajectory of work. A live alternative is that the verses only state forensic recompense without a route mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus permits a generic blocked-route punishment.
changed_reading.after: The route is the object actually followed, and the stability or instability of that orientation is reproduced inside the work itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: 47:4 places testing and death beside a near-verbatim way-loss-work sequence but negates the loss. Severe interruption therefore does not itself make work disappear; orientation in the way distinguishes preserved work from directionless work.

activation_trace.role: A test that makes condition appear frames the surrounding actions as exposed rather than automatically erased.
Actual loss of life provides the maximal interruption against which work is nevertheless preserved.
The traversed route supplies the positive orientation attached to the preserved works.
Loss of a thing is explicitly denied here, turning the repeated root into a contrastive preservation signal.
Purposive acts persist as the same object that was caused to lose direction in the focus.

structural_cues: 47:4 reproduces the focus way-loss-work triad inside a future clause whose negation reverses the focus result.
The preservation statement follows a long sequence of exposure, restraint, release, burden-laying, testing, and death.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated triad, explicit negation, and testing sequence; I infer that relation to the way, not mere interruption or death, governs whether work remains findable. A live alternative is a promise of reward with no lexical preservation mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Causative loss could mean that any externally interrupted undertaking vanishes.
changed_reading.after: Even death need not lose an undertaking; work aligned with the way remains held, while obstructive work loses its course.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate explanation in 47:9 links aversion to what was delivered with a second predicate over works. Its material branches allow a process in which bad intake produces impressive swelling but then drops or fails. Focus work-loss can thus be an endogenous collapse of malformed activity, not only external removal.

activation_trace.role: Disappearance is the baseline result now supplied with a possible internal process.
Affective repulsion supplies the rejection of formative input.
Something conveyed to its recipients supplies the input against which the work is formed.
A body distended by unwholesome consumption gives a material image for activity enlarged by what ultimately ruins it.
Downward collapse supplies the terminal movement of the malformed work.
Intended activity is the object that swells in appearance yet fails in constitution.

structural_cues: 47:8 repeats the focus result, and 47:9 immediately introduces a causal explanation while replacing the loss verb with another verb governing works.
The explanatory sequence runs from aversion to delivered input to the condition of the resulting work.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, causal syntax, aversion, delivery, and somatic-collapse branches; I infer that rejected input makes the work internally self-defeating. A live alternative is that the second predicate is only a conventional synonym for invalidation.

changed_reading.before: Works disappear through an external act after they are complete.
changed_reading.after: Works can carry the defect of their rejected input, expand without sound growth, and collapse from within.

context_deltas.mechanism: Travel through the land and inspection of prior endings turn the focus route into a historical track. A work is not only a momentary act but an aftermath that should remain inspectable; causative loss means failure to leave a viable destination, successor state, or beneficial trace.

activation_trace.role: The focus route becomes the path along which historical consequences can be inspected.
Purposeful activity is extended into the trace it leaves behind.
Physical movement supplies the reader's traversal of earlier agents' trajectories.
Directed sight and reflection make the remaining consequence an object of inspection.
The terminal state of a process supplies the destination by which a work is evaluated.
Comprehensive destruction supplies the absence of a viable successor state.
A warning sign left for others shows that even failed work can leave a negative evidentiary trace.

structural_cues: 47:10 orders movement first, perception second, and examination of an ending third.
The prior populations are gone, yet their aftermath remains readable as a repeated pattern.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies travel, looking, ending, destruction, and an exemplary remainder; I infer that the focus evaluates work by the destination and trace it generates. A live alternative is that 47:10 is only a separate historical warning.

changed_reading.before: The lost works are isolated items in an unseen ledger.
changed_reading.after: The lost works are failed trajectories whose historical aftermath has no viable continuation, even though their ruin remains legible as warning.

context_deltas.mechanism: 47:11 contrasts an unbroken nearness and active charge for one group with the absence of such charge for the other. The focus work can therefore be lost not only by taking a wrong course but by lacking the proximal custody that carries, preserves, or answers for it.

activation_trace.role: The focus identifies the route by relation to the worshipped authority who later supplies custody.
Loss from an owner is the focus state that custody could prevent.
The work is the item needing continuity of relation and preservation.
Nearness without an intervening gap supplies continuity between an agent, authority, and work.
Taking active charge supplies the preserving function, while its explicit absence marks exposure to loss.
Settled trust supplies the relational posture in which proximal custody can operate.
Concealed orientation marks the contrasted group for whom preserving charge is negated.

structural_cues: 47:11 assigns the same relational noun positively to one group and negates it for the other.
The contrast occurs immediately after the command to inspect the destroyed aftermath of earlier rejecters.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed custody relations and the focus's possessed works; I infer that unbroken nearness can carry work through to preservation. A live alternative is that the relation concerns persons only and does not mediate their works.

changed_reading.before: Work reaches or fails solely because of its intrinsic direction.
changed_reading.after: A coexisting reading makes preservation relational: work held in proximal charge remains connected, while work without such custody becomes ownerless in effect.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence from hearing without retained understanding to locked hearts recasts the focus covering and obstruction as an internal information gate. Signals arrive, but inclination redirects attention and closure prevents assembly and consequence-sensitive deliberation; the lost works include the mind's attempted operation, not only outward deeds.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the internal occlusion that keeps heard material from becoming available.
Failure of retention supplies a specific cognitive mode of work-loss.
Putting the mind or an instrument to work expands the focus object to operative cognition.
Hearing that should become understanding or response supplies the input that fails to take hold.
Tracing an influence step by step supplies the competing attentional route.
Personal inclination supplies the force that redirects received material away from deliberation.
Considering an affair through its consequences supplies the mental operation that closure blocks.
Gathering dispersed material into a whole supplies the integrative operation required for comprehension.
Hard closure supplies the gate that prevents integration and recovery.

structural_cues: 47:16 stages audible reception followed by an immediate question that displays failure to retain content.
47:24 later opposes consequence-sensitive deliberation to closures located on hearts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reception, failed recall, redirected following, deliberation, gathering, and closure; I infer an information-flow failure that disables mental work. A live alternative is culpable refusal without any cognitive-process claim.

changed_reading.before: The focus works are only external performances whose credit is removed.
changed_reading.after: The works can include failed operations of attention, retention, integration, and deliberation produced by self-maintained occlusion.

context_deltas.mechanism: 47:22 turns away from a single abstract route toward a social network: withdrawal leads to loss of fitness in the land and severance of kin connections. Since work can be interaction between people, blocking the way can make one's operations fail by destroying the relationships through which action is transmitted, reciprocated, and sustained.

activation_trace.role: Turning others aside supplies the outward social interruption.
People who occupy and traverse routes make the way a network rather than only a line.
Loss supplies the fate of work when its relational carriers are removed.
Transactions and dealings supply the socially distributed form of work.
Turning one's back supplies the withdrawal that initiates network failure.
Departure from fitness supplies the system-level result of broken relations.
Deliberate rupture of connection supplies the mechanism by which a social path stops carrying action.
Kin relation supplies the concrete network edge being cut.

structural_cues: 47:22 is conditional: turning away is followed by corruption in the land and cutting kin relations.
The focus has both self-turning and other-diverting available in one obstruction root, allowing individual and network scales to coexist.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withdrawal, system corruption, severed kinship, and a focus branch for interpersonal dealings; I infer that relationships are transmission paths for work. A live alternative is that social rupture is a separate consequence, not the process by which work is lost.

changed_reading.before: The divine way is only an individual route, and each work succeeds or fails in isolation.
changed_reading.after: The way can be a social topology; those who cut its relations also remove the carriers through which their own dealings could endure.

context_deltas.mechanism: 47:25 supplies an explicit backward vector after guidance has become exposed, and 47:28 returns to following and collapsed works. Focus diversion is therefore not only failure to find a route; it can be deliberate retrogression that converts accumulated progress into backtracking.

activation_trace.role: Turning aside supplies the reversible vector now sharpened into backward motion.
A traversable route allows progress and retrogression to be measured on the same axis.
Deviation from destination is revised from passive wandering to active reversal.
Return toward an earlier position supplies the primary backward movement.
Presenting the back and withdrawing gives bodily orientation to the reversal.
Prior exposure removes simple lack of route knowledge as the only explanation.
Gentle direction to a path supplies the known forward vector being abandoned.
Following supplies the chosen attachment that drives the reversed course.
Collapse supplies the fate of progress converted into backward movement.
Intended works are the accumulated motion undone by retrogression.

structural_cues: 47:25 orders clarity and guidance before the explicit backward movement.
47:28 repeats following as cause and again places collapsed works as result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a known forward direction, a bodily backward vector, chosen following, and collapsed work; I infer that work-loss can be reversal of prior progress. A live alternative is simple apostasy language with no claim about accumulated work as distance.

changed_reading.before: The agents never found the route, so their works wandered accidentally.
changed_reading.after: A coexisting reading makes the loss retrograde: after the route is exposed, chosen backtracking consumes the progress their works had represented.

context_deltas.mechanism: 47:29-31 repeatedly moves what is inward into visible signs, speech patterns, knowledge, and testing. This weakens a total-erasure reading: work may be lost as successful efficacy while remaining available as diagnostic residue that identifies its maker under pressure.

activation_trace.role: Concealed disappearance supplies the reading now limited by later disclosure.
Purposeful action remains the object whose efficacy and evidentiary trace can diverge.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the transition from latency to evidence.
A visible sign by which condition is inferred supplies the person's readable surface.
A slant in expression that points beyond explicit wording supplies a second diagnostic channel.
Disclosure to a knower prevents hidden work from becoming ontologically absent.
Testing that reveals condition supplies the pressure under which latent dispositions become acts.
Knowledge of an affair's interior supplies the retained report left by tested conduct.

structural_cues: The root ض غ ن at 47:29 has no branch inventory and is used only as the packet's structural label for concealed material brought outward.
47:30 explicitly joins readable marks and speech inflection to knowledge of works; 47:31 then tests persons and their reports.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden material, emergence, marks, inflected speech, known works, and revealing tests; I infer a distinction between lost positive efficacy and retained diagnostic evidence. A live alternative is that the signs identify persons independently of their works.

changed_reading.before: To lose works means that no trace of them remains anywhere.
changed_reading.after: Their works can fail as beneficial outcomes while surviving as involuntary signatures that expose the dispositions producing them.

context_deltas.mechanism: 47:32 repeats the focus obstruction almost exactly, adds open opposition, denies any resulting damage to the divine source, and redirects collapse onto the agents' works. The following warning not to invalidate one's own works makes the mechanism reflexive and avoidable: blockage cannot injure the source of the way, so it consumes the blocker-side operation.

activation_trace.role: Diversion repeats the focus action as the attempted outward interference.
The route is again the channel the agents try to obstruct.
A group split by opposition supplies the intensified social form of obstruction.
Deficiency or damage is explicitly denied at the intended divine target.
Collapse relocates the actual loss onto the obstructors' own activity.
The agents' intended acts receive the damage their opposition cannot transmit outward.
Active removal of validity supplies a warned-against self-directed operation.
The second-person works show that collapse is a live relational risk, not a fixed property of one label.

structural_cues: 47:32 repeats the focus population, obstruction, way, and works while inserting opposition and an explicit denial of harm to God.
47:33 immediately changes audience and warns that works can be invalidated, preserving agency in the relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attempted obstruction, denied outward damage, inward work-collapse, and a warning against self-invalidation; I infer a reflexive causal circuit. A live alternative is a sequence of separate legal consequences rather than returned obstruction.

changed_reading.before: Their obstruction succeeds against the way and is then punished independently.
changed_reading.after: The obstruction cannot damage its intended source; its effective result closes back on the agents' own operations and makes them collapse.

context_deltas.mechanism: 47:35 explicitly denies that aligned works will be shorted, and 47:36 names compensation. This separates the focus loss from arbitrary confiscation by a payer: directionless work fails as work or loses its return-path, whereas preserved work is not deprived of what is due.

activation_trace.role: Loss of a possessed item supplies the ambiguity between failed work and withheld return.
Compensation attached to labor supplies the baseline claim that context now constrains.
Being deprived of a right or work is explicitly negated, ruling out arbitrary shortchanging for the contrasted group.
The labor-return branch makes the negated deprivation directly answer the exploratory baseline.
Compensation for work confirms that due return is tracked rather than indiscriminately erased.

structural_cues: 47:35 negates deprivation with works as the direct object, and 47:36 immediately promises compensation.
This positive assurance follows the warning in 47:33 that agents can invalidate their own works.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit non-deprivation, work, and compensation; I infer that the focus loss cannot be reduced to divine underpayment and instead concerns the work's viability or return-path. A live alternative is that the two groups simply receive unrelated verdicts.

changed_reading.before: The focus may depict a payer withholding the value of completed labor.
changed_reading.after: The text distinguishes nonpayment from failure: viable work is not shorted, while obstructive work loses the relation that would make its return due and reachable.

context_deltas.mechanism: 47:38 places expenditure inside the way and frames withholding as directed against the withholder's own self, while the self-sufficient source can replace the group. A branch image of a passage with an outlet turns giving into throughput: the blocker becomes a bottleneck, its dealings cease to circulate, and the network substitutes another carrier.

activation_trace.role: A material barrier supplies the bottleneck imposed on the outgoing path.
Interpersonal dealings supply the kind of work that depends on continued circulation.
A through-passage with an exit supplies the conduit model for value leaving one holder and reaching another.
The traversable route is the named channel in which expenditure is placed.
Withholding supplies the closure that stops value from moving through the conduit.
The agent's own entity is named as the terminal bearer of the blockage's harm.
Sufficiency shows that the source does not depend on the blocked contribution.
Need marks the blocker, not the source, as vulnerable to interrupted circulation.
One entity standing in another's place supplies the network response to a failed carrier.
A human collective supplies the replaceable carrier-node rather than an isolated deed.

structural_cues: 47:38 places expenditure grammatically within the same way named in the focus, repeats withholding three times, and locates its consequence at the self.
The root ض غ ن at 47:37 lacks a branch inventory and is used only as a structural cue: pressure on giving makes concealed resistance emerge before the conduit scene.
The closing replacement clause makes failure of circulation a reason for changing carriers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies expenditure in the way, a through-passage branch, repeated withholding, reflexive harm, sufficiency, need, and replacement; I infer a circulation network in which obstructive agents are bypassed. A live alternative is a financial exhortation unrelated to the focus work-loss mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Lost works are deleted units belonging only to an isolated individual.
changed_reading.after: Works can be flows through a shared route; withholding makes the agent a failed conduit, returns the loss to that self, and permits replacement by another carrier.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines form-distant agricultural branches of two focus roots. It remains anchored in the focus's covering, way, work, and disappearance sequence and is activated by contextual water-flow and useful-fruit branches. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for productive failure, not claim that the focus nouns lexically denote seed or grain.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Words 2, 5, 7, and 8 can be held together as seed-covering, an ear-bearing growth path, burial-like disappearance, and purposive cultivation.

activation_trace.role: Covering seed with earth supplies an act that can begin growth but can also leave labor buried.
The extended grain-bearing form supplies the unrealized productive destination.
Buried disappearance supplies seed or labor that never emerges into a visible result.
Intended labor supplies cultivation whose success should become observable yield.
Continuous flow supplies the movement needed to carry productive input.
Water cutting a channel through earth supplies sustained irrigation rather than blocked passage.
Delivery of water supplies the input by which covered seed could emerge.
A useful yield supplies the missing endpoint by which cultivation becomes successful work.

changed_reading.before: Covering is uniformly negative and the works simply vanish.
changed_reading.after: Covering is an ambiguous productive operation: without an open channel and right input, buried labor never emerges into useful yield.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins a screen, an eye membrane, disappearance, and mental operation across distant branches. It remains valid as an anchored analogy because the focus contains covering, obstruction, way, loss, and work, while 47:23-24 supplies blindness, inward sight, and closure. Downstream prose should qualify it as an optical-cognitive model and must not replace the ordinary route sense with an eye disease.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus roots at words 2, 3, 5, 7, and 8 permit obstruction to be rendered as a screen over the faculty that must see and work out a route.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the general occlusive layer.
A portable screen supplies a more specific interface between perceiver and route.
A woven-looking film over the eye turns the blocked way into impaired route-perception.
Hiddenness supplies the result of a route no longer available to sight.
Operative thought supplies the faculty disabled by the self-made screen.
Loss of inward sight transfers the optical image into discernment.
Inner vision supplies the faculty that would otherwise recognize the route.
Hard closure stabilizes the occlusion so the mental operation cannot reopen access.

changed_reading.before: They knowingly see the route and only stop other travelers.
changed_reading.after: Their outward screening can coexist with a reflexive optical effect: the obstruction becomes a membrane over their own operative discernment.

strongest_changes: The near-verbatim negation at 47:4 shows that interruption and death do not by themselves lose work; orientation in the way can preserve it.
The paired following contrast at 47:2-3 makes work-loss formative and directional: activity takes on the stability of what it trails.
The exact reprise at 47:32 denies damage to the divine source and relocates collapse onto the obstructors' own works, strongly supporting a reflexive mechanism.
The disclosure-and-testing sequence at 47:29-31 distinguishes lost beneficial efficacy from retained diagnostic residue.
The non-deprivation and compensation language at 47:35-36 prevents the labor reading from becoming arbitrary wage confiscation.
The final expenditure, self-harm, and replacement sequence activates a circulation model in which blockers become failed conduits.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's compact cover-block-way-loss-work chain was repeatedly re-run under opposite signs: repaired versus collapsed, preserved versus lost, forward guidance versus retrogression, hidden material versus exposed signature, and outgoing circulation versus withholding. Form-distant branches generated agricultural and optical models that stayed visibly anchored without being promoted to exclusive meanings. Branchless ض غ ن cues were kept structural and no branch identifier was invented.
remaining_uncertainties: Causative loss can still denote several coexisting targets: destination, recoverability, beneficial efficacy, retained memory, or compensable return.
The proximal-custody reading may describe preservation of persons rather than a mechanism acting directly on works.
The social-network and circulation models rely on a reader-supplied claim that relations are carriers of work, although the packet strongly supplies their severance and replacement.
The agricultural and optical outliers are material analogies from distant branches and should remain explicitly exploratory.
